<p class="ac-item-meta">Czechoslovakia · Monthly · November 1929–August 1938 · 106 complete months</p>
<p>An eight-indicator Financial Stress Index and an eleven-indicator Macro-Financial Stress Index. Explore the monthly chronology, component blocks, the February 1934 monetary break and robustness results, with figures and downloadable revised reader data.</p>

<section class="level2" id="european-bilateral-trade-19271938">
<h2 data-anchor-id="european-bilateral-trade-19271938">European bilateral trade, 1927–1938</h2>
<p class="ac-item-meta">
21 European economies · Annual · Country-pair-year observations
</p>
<p>A bilateral trade panel covering twelve annual cross-sections. It can be used to study changes in trade partners, the persistence of commercial relationships and the geography of European trade during the Great Depression.</p>
<p>Repository title: <em>Commercial Hysteresis: Persistence and Reorganization in Europe’s Bilateral Trade Geography during the Great Depression.</em></p>
<p><a href="https://doi.org/10.3886/E247132V2">Dataset and documentation</a> · DOI: 10.3886/E247132V2</p>
</section>
</div>

<h2 data-anchor-id="the-missing-j"><a href="the-missing-j.html">The Missing J</a></h2>
<p class="ac-item-meta">Monthly archive: 1925–1936 · Preferred European panel: 18 economies, 1928–1936</p>
<p>Effective exchange rates and trade-balance adjustment in interwar Europe. Explore the fast, temporary response of export values relative to import values, national devaluation paths and the construction of the European partner-weighted rates.</p>
<p>The reader page includes seven figures, methods, coverage, conference robustness results and downloadable data with a variable dictionary.</p>
<p><a href="the-missing-j.html">Data overview, figures and methods</a> · <a href="assets/files/datasets/missing-j/data/reader-monthly-panel.csv" download>Monthly reader panel (CSV)</a> · <a href="https://doi.org/10.3886/E251239V1">openICPSR V1 deposit</a></p>
</section>
